dedupe_keys.name: compose informal waste collector and aggregator surveys in six vietnamese cities

description: This collection groups six coordinated COMPOSE deposits on informal recyclable-waste collectors and aggregator warehouses in Vinh, Da Nang, Nha Trang, Buon Ma Thuot, Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. Hanoi Architectural University, Kyoto University and local collaborators document warehouse surroundings, building form, operating hours, collected materials and owner characteristics. DataSuds provides city tables and dictionaries as tab-separated and text files, free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Repository survey periods span 2019–2020; the article also describes earlier Hanoi work during 2017–2019. Coverage is the surveyed urban informal systems. Public data remove identifiers, generalise attributes and aggregate records, limiting facility-level reconstruction. Modellers could estimate actor characteristics or collection participation in recycling simulations. model-comses-rac-serious-game-solid-waste-vietnam is a related model. The Hanoi component shares a research lineage with the later G2-0351 facility workbook, but overlap was not quantified and the two should not be pooled blindly. All six metadata pages and licences were read; no survey files were downloaded.
